description: cbbackupmgr-strategies.md recommends the 'periodic merge' strategy (daily incrementals, merged weekly, never a second full backup) without repeating that the merge command it depends on is Enterprise-only, per cbbackupmgr-merge.md's own reference page ('The merge command is an Enterprise Edition command'). A Community Edition reader following the strategies page's own recommendation as written would only discover the gate by separately reading the merge command's reference page.
